Operator, builder, and player tooling for Andara's World

Usage:
  andara-cli [flags]
  andara-cli [command]

Available Commands:
  account      Create and administer accounts (operator)
  auth         Log in, log out, and inspect the stored credential
  completion   Generate shell completion scripts
  config       Show and inspect CLI configuration
  content      Compile, format, and decompile Content Language packs (builder)
  help         Help about any command
  invite       Issue and revoke invite codes (operator)
  play         Enter the world: a text interface over the Protocol
  registration Switch the registration mode (operator)
  sim          Run the simulation in-process against content on disk (developer)
  snapshot     Inspect Zone snapshots in the configured store (operator)
  version      Print version, commit, and build date

Flags:
      --config string           config file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/cli.yaml)
      --credentials string      credential file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/credentials.yaml)
  -h, --help                    help for andara-cli
      --log-level string        CLI diagnostic level (default "warn")
      --no-color                disable ANSI output
  -o, --output string           output format: human or json (default "human")
      --server-address string   server endpoint (gRPC/Connect over TLS) (default "localhost:8443")
      --timeout duration        per-command deadline (default 30s)
      --tls-ca string           CA bundle to trust (empty uses the system trust store)

Use "andara-cli [command] --help" for more information about a command.
